name: Article 1 – § 1 – point 1; Directive (EU) 2015/637 – Article 7 – after paragraph 4 – 19
title: REPORT on the draft for a Council directive amending Directive (EU) 2015/637 on the coordination and cooperation measures to facilitate consular protection for unrepresented citizens of the Union in third countries and Directive (EU) 2019/997 establishing an EU Emergency Travel Document
part_text: Amendment 5a. The EEAS, in close cooperation with Member States, shall provide consular crisis preparedness and response training to Union officials.
